candidates.text: Business RequirementThe system should restrict and display only the Consignor Address and Location values that belong to the selected Execution Company & Factory.
Default values are auto-populated based on selected company and factory.
ScopeThis requirement applies to a Pre-shipment Export Invoice where Execution Company and Factory are selected and Consignor Address and Location Name are required.
Dropdown values for Consignor Address and Location Name should be restricted/filtered only to records that belong to the selected Execution Company & Factory in the Division Consignor Master.

Section 1: OverviewPurpose To automatically default the values in Consignor Address and Location Name fields on the Pre-Shipment Export Invoice screen, based on the selected Execution Company and Factory. This ensures accuracy, reduces manual entry, and improves efficiency.Business RequirementThe system should restrict and display only the Consignor Address and Location values that belong to the selected Execution Company & Factory.If a user has access to multiple companies/divisions, once they select a company and factory, the dropdown for Consignor Address and Location should be filtered accordingly.Default values should be pre-populated based on:Execution CompanySelected FactoryThis will minimize errors caused by users accidentally selecting invalid addresses.Expected Outcome:User sees only relevant Consignor Address and Location options in dropdowns.Default values are auto-populated based on selected company and factory.Reduces risk of incorrect data entry in export documentation.ScopeThis requirement applies to a Pre-shipment Export Invoice where Execution Company and Factory are selected and Consignor Address and Location Name are required.Requirement:

When user selects an Execution Company and Factory, the system should:Pick up the Consignor Address and Location Name automatically from the Division Consignor Master.Populate them as default values in the respective fields.Dropdown values for Consignor Address and Location Name should be restricted/filtered only to records that belong to the selected Execution Company & Factory in the Division Consignor Master.Section 2. Assumptions This change will not impact on existing functionalities.Section 3.
